ticket.station_access.fare: Entry is free; exit consumes 1 credit if available.
ui.station_access.title: Access Configurator
ui.station_access.recharge_rule: 1 emerald adds 10 credits. Exit consumes 1 credit if available.
ui.station_access.choose_ticket: Top-ups use the main-hand ticket, then the offhand ticket, then the first ticket in inventory slot order. A new ticket is issued only if you have none. If the inventory is full when issuing a new ticket, no emerald is taken.
ui.station_access.select_hint: Left-click the first point, then left-click the second point to save. Right-click for the area list.
message.station_access.owner: Only the owner or an administrator can change this area.
message.station_access.denied: A valid ticket with enough credit is required to enter.
message.station_access.emerald: You need an emerald in your inventory.
message.station_access.reselect: First point stays fixed. Left-click a new second point.
message.station_access.deleted: Area removed; empty-space barriers will be cleared in batches.
message.station_access.two_points: Choose two corners in the same dimension.
message.station_access.size: Select two different corners enclosing a hollow volume, within world height.
message.station_access.created: Area saved. Existing walls remain intact.
help.station_access.setter.title: Access Configurator
help.station_access.setter.line1: With the access setter, left-click the first corner, aim to preview, then left-click the second corner to save immediately. Right-click the list to toggle visibility, choose 16 colours, change the second corner or delete. The first corner stays fixed. Frames appear only while holding the tool; hiding does not disable access rules or place solid blocks.
help.station_access.setter.line2: Walking in requires a valid ticket with uses, but entry is not charged. Q5 train passengers may enter without inspection. Exit is unrestricted: one use is charged if available, otherwise nothing. A single exit is not charged repeatedly. Real walls still block movement.
help.station_access.setter.line3: 256 durability; successful creation or update costs 1. Creative costs nothing.
help.station_access.ticket.title: Travel Card
help.station_access.ticket.line1: Tickets have no survival recipe. Buy them at the terminal in Survival/Adventure; Creative also offers them in the item tab. Switching to a held ticket briefly shows its remaining uses above the hotbar; spending and top-ups refresh it.
help.station_access.ticket.line2: Place and right-click the terminal, then buy uses: 1 emerald adds 10, capped at 30000. Top-ups use the main-hand ticket, then the offhand ticket, then the first ticket in inventory slot order. A new ticket is issued only if you have none. If the inventory is full when issuing a new ticket, no emerald is taken.
help.station_access.ticket.line3: Walking in requires a valid ticket with uses, but entry is not charged. Q5 train passengers may enter without inspection. Exit is unrestricted: one use is charged if available, otherwise nothing. A single exit is not charged repeatedly. Real walls still block movement.
